finding: At 3 a.m., 929 of the 2,138 quarter-mile blocks with a bus at the morning peak still have one. About 390,000 Chicagoans live more than a half mile from a bus or train leaving that hour.

ledger.units: bus departures per quarter-mile block per hour
method: every bus leaving every stop on Tuesday 17 Nov 2026, times past 24:00 folded onto the morning
quarter-mile blocks centered on the quarter-mile lines of the address grid
